highlights: Designed the reinforced-concrete structural system for an amphitheater seating approximately 450 people, including the tiered seating and roof structure.
Verified the seismic-resistant design in compliance with NSR-10, defining the seismic-force-resisting system and reinforcement detailing for critical elements.
Coordinated structural design with architecture to reconcile the tiered seating's curved geometry with the required reinforcement ratios and rebar layouts.
